simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יֶרַח (H3391) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: יֶרַח (yerach) means a lunation , i.e. month First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 6 37.

definitions.full: H3391. yerach I. יֶ֫רַח noun masculine Zech 11:8 month (Aramaic יַרְחָא , new moon, month ; Palmyrene ירח Vog No. 1 ; Assyrian ar— u COT Glossary Muss-Arn JBL xi. 1892, 73, 163 ; compare Phoenician Ethiopic below יָרֵחַ ; Sabean ורחֿ month , DHM ZMG 1876, 603; 1883, 369 Hal JAS vii, 1, 516 ) — absolute יֶ֫רַח 1Kin 6:37 3 t.; construct id. Deut 21:13 ; 2Kin 15:13 ; plural יְרָחִים Exod 2:2-3 t.; construct יַרְחֵי Job 7:3 ; 29:2 ; — 1 month , as measure of time, during, or in which Exod 2:2 (E), Zech 11:8 ; Job 39:2 ; שָׁ֑וְא יַרְחֵי 7:3 ; קֶדֶם יַרְחֵי 29:2 ; pleonastic יָמִים יֶרַח a month ( of ) days = a month of time Deut 21:13 ; 2Kin 15:13 . 2 calendar month , with name זִו יֶרַח 1Kin 6:37 (2nd mo., compare 6:1 ); בּוּל יֶרַח 6:38 (8th mo.); הָאֵתָנִים יֶרַךְ 8:2 (7th mo.); compare אַליָֿבאֹ יְרָחִים בְּמִסְמַּר Job 3:6 ; יְרָתִים גֶּרֶשׁ Deut 33:4 produce of months , i.e. of various seasons of year. — compare synonym חֹדֶשׁ . [ יְרַךְ ] noun masculine month (see Biblical Hebrew); — absolute אֲדָר לִירַח Ezra 6:15 ; plural absolute יַרְחִין Dan 4:26 .
